findings.summary: The new predecode memory reservation still leaves gRPC HTTP/2 transport allocations outside its bound.
findings.evidence: docs/issues/91/reader-contract.md:109-117 reserves 2*receiveLimit+64KiB+1MiB per call and promises all four raw/decoded calls plus retained views remain in the same64MiB pool, but specifies neither client flow-control windows nor received header-list limits. In pinned grpc1.85.0, internal/transport/http2_client.go:405-411 enables BDP growth by default; bdp_estimator.go:27-30 permits16MiB windows; http2_client.go:1199-1217,1222-1301 grows each stream and queues incoming DATA before CodecV2 runs; transport.go:90-139 stores this in recvBuffer. A hostile metadata peer can send additional unary-response DATA while a valid first response is decoding, so the 4MiB/512KiB message cap does not cap queued transport bytes. Four warmed16MiB stream backlogs alone consume the entire pool before raw messages/retained views. Independently, defaults.go:47 permits16MiB received header lists before the codec, exceeding even a full-response reservation and far exceeding a page reservation. Structural Pass1 cannot prevent these prior allocations. Primary sources: [BDP limit](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/blob/v1.85.0/internal/transport/bdp_estimator.go), [transport queue and flow control](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/blob/v1.85.0/internal/transport/http2_client.go), [header defaults](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/blob/v1.85.0/internal/transport/defaults.go).
findings.fix: Specify concrete client transport limits and account their maximum live memory in the existing pool: disable BDP with pinned grpc.WithStaticStreamWindowSize/WithStaticConnWindowSize (including the per-message adjustWindow allowance), set a small explicit grpc.WithMaxHeaderListSize, and bound/count live transports and frame/HPACK/queue scratch. Keep receive caps and fail before opening a call when reserved credit is unavailable. Add malicious real-HTTP2/gRPC fixtures that warm BDP, send extra unary-response DATA while decode is paused, and hit header/trailer-list boundary/+1; assert combined transport/decoded/retained high-water usage and reclamation, including512KiB pages and four calls. The [pinned public dial options](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/blob/v1.85.0/dialoptions.go) supply the necessary controls; no dependency plan needs reopening.
